assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art university affiliation icon for a personal academic website.
Input image 1: official Zhejiang University emblem from the university website, used as the identity and color reference. Transform this emblem into one square pixel-art icon.
Subject: Zhejiang University emblem: the distinctive centered Qiushi eagle with broad upward-spread wings and a tapered tiered body, inside its official circular seal. Keep this specific eagle silhouette recognizable. Use truth-seeking blue #003F88 and transparent negative space; a small amount of white within the emblem is allowed only where essential.
Style/medium: crisp handcrafted pixel art on a 64 by 64 logical pixel grid, enlarged as sharp square blocks. Consistent square pixel size, deliberate stair-step diagonals, limited flat palette. No smoothing, antialiasing, gradients, glows, shadows, texture, or 3D effects.
Composition: square canvas, centered emblem occupying about 80 percent of both canvas dimensions, with equal transparent padding around the circular seal. Preserve the official circular border as part of the emblem, not an added frame. Replace the tiny illegible perimeter lettering and founding-year numerals with clean empty space; no text or glyph-like marks anywhere. The central eagle must dominate and stay faithful to the reference.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including all pixels outside the emblem. Do not draw a checkerboard or solid background.
Constraints: only one Zhejiang University symbol, no labels, extra text, decorative frames, invented symbols, or unrelated objects.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one clean transparent pixel-art company icon using the official Lightwheel reference image. Preserve its circular silhouette and the exact recognizable three-armed pale central shape and surrounding blue/violet regions. Render as a deliberately coarse 64x64 logical pixel-grid sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. IMPORTANT: only SIX perfectly flat solid colors total: pale icy white for the central junction, sky blue, royal blue, deep navy, violet, light lavender. Each colored region must be a flat solid fill, with no gradient strips, no shading, no texture and no fine visual noise. Make bold stepped pixel edges. The circle must occupy exactly about 80% of the square canvas width, leaving a generous completely empty transparent margin on all four sides. Transparent alpha background. No letters, no words, no wordmark, no frame, no glow, no blur, no antialiasing, no shadows. The result should look like a compact retro game UI sprite of this company's official symbol.
assets.notes: Pixel-art interpretation of the official website favicon. Source files were viewed before generation. No manual image processing.
